description: This file contains a PHPUnit test case class for the PimDefinedReportService within the OrangeHRM PIM plugin. It sets up the test environment, initializes the service, and includes a test method to verify the retrieval of a ReportGeneratorDao instance.

classes.name: PimDefinedReportServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case for the ReportGeneratorService related to PimDefinedReport in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, including the creation of a ReportGeneratorService instance and populating test data from a YAML fixture.

methods.name: testGetReportGeneratorDao
methods.description: Tests whether the getReportGeneratorDao method of ReportGeneratorService returns an instance of ReportGeneratorDao.
